experiments.research_question: How can single-cell foundation models be fine-tuned to predict transcriptional responses to novel molecular perturbations, including zero-shot generalization to unseen cell lines?

limitations.statement: scDCA is currently only applicable to transformer-based foundation models; it cannot be directly applied to other model types without significant adaptation.
scDCA requires the presence of control gene expression data; if the dataset does not include control gene expressions, the approach cannot be utilized.
Evaluation of perturbation models, especially for generalization to new cell lines and conditions, is challenged by the limited size of publicly available data.

methods.description: Single-cell Drug-Conditional Adapter: efficient fine-tuning of a single-cell foundation model (scGPT) by training less than 1% of the original model parameters via a drug-conditional adapter module that incorporates molecular structure information while keeping the FM weights frozen.
methods.name: scDCA
methods.protocol: Single-cell Drug-Conditional Adapter: efficient fine-tuning of a single-cell foundation model (scGPT) by training less than 1% of the original model parameters via a drug-conditional adapter module that incorporates molecular structure information while keeping the FM weights frozen.

methods.description: Standard fine-tuning of scGPT by training all or most parameters on the perturbation prediction task.
methods.name: scGPT fine-tuning (naive)
methods.protocol: Standard fine-tuning of scGPT by training all or most parameters on the perturbation prediction task.

methods.description: Encoder-decoder architecture with separate embeddings for molecule and cell line, using an adversarial classifier for invariant basal states.
methods.name: ChemCPA
methods.protocol: Encoder-decoder architecture with separate embeddings for molecule and cell line, using an adversarial classifier for invariant basal states.

methods.description: Deep generative framework for disentangled representations in single-cell data, partitioning latent space into subspaces for cell lines and perturbations.
methods.name: BioLORD
methods.protocol: Deep generative framework for disentangled representations in single-cell data, partitioning latent space into subspaces for cell lines and perturbations.

methods.description: Sparse Additive Mechanism Shift Variational Autoencoder employing additive conditioning for perturbation prediction.
methods.name: SAMS-VAE
methods.protocol: Sparse Additive Mechanism Shift Variational Autoencoder employing additive conditioning for perturbation prediction.
